notes.title: 🧩 Dot Piece Puzzle Ver. 1.0.3 Update 🧩
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951646/2e007e6a090ee13118e71f860251122aa7d98e32.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Dot Piece Puzzle!

We've updated the game to version 1.0.3.

What's New:

- Added "VSync" option for smoother movement (recommended ON).
- Renamed "Fullscreen" option to "Screen Mode" (no function change).
- The default volume for MUSIC and SOUND EFFECT has been changed from 80% to 50% on initial startup.

We hope you continue to enjoy Dot Piece Puzzle! 🧩

notes.title: 🧩"Dot Piece Puzzle" Update: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Dot Piece Puzzle!

We're excited to announce a new update that brings Dot Piece Puzzle to version 1.0.2!
We've listened to your feedback and worked hard to squash some bugs and improve your overall experience.

Patch Notes:

・Language auto-detection: The game will now automatically select the language that matches your Steam UI settings when you launch it for the first time (supported languages only).
・Mouse wheel zoom: For more convenient puzzle solving, you can now use your mouse wheel to zoom in and out.
・Improved dot piece colors: We've adjusted the colors of some dot pieces for better visibility.

We're committed to making Dot Piece Puzzle the best it can be.
Please continue sharing your feedback and suggestions – we love hearing from you!

Thank you for continuing to puzzle with us! 🧩

notes.title: 🧩"Dot Piece Puzzle" Update: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the release of a new update for "Dot Piece Puzzle", bringing the game to version 1.0.1!

We've been listening to your feedback and working hard to address some pesky bugs and make a few tweaks to enhance your gaming experience.

What's New in Version 1.0.1:

We're committed to providing you with a smooth and enjoyable "Dot Piece Puzzle" experience.
If you have any further feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Thank you for continuing to "Dot Piece Puzzle" with us! 🧩

notes.title: "Dot Piece Puzzle" is Now Available for Purchase!
notes.content:
Thank you for your interest in our game "Dot Piece Puzzle"!

We are thrilled to announce that the two issues affecting "Dot Piece Puzzle" have been resolved:

1. "Dot Piece Puzzle"'s price is now displayed correctly.
2. "Dot Piece Puzzle" can now be purchased.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused to those who were eagerly awaiting the release.

We are committed to providing you with a fun and engaging gaming experience. 
Thank you for your continued support of "Dot Piece Puzzle"!

notes.title: Notice of Issues with Price and Purchase
notes.content:
We would like to thank you for your interest in "Dot Piece Puzzle".

We are currently aware of two issues affecting some users:

1. The price of "Dot Piece Puzzle" is not displayed.
2. "Dot Piece Puzzle" cannot be purchased.

We are currently working on a fix for these issues. Once the issues are resolved, we will announce it on this community hub.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience as we work to resolve these issues.

We are committed to meeting the expectations of those who have been looking forward to the release. 
We hope you will continue to support "Dot Piece Puzzle".
